import numpy as np
# Baseline correction: line between mean of 1090-1110 and 1790-1810
def get_mean(arr_x, arr_y, center):
    mask = (arr_x >= center - 10) & (arr_x <= center + 10)
    if not np.any(mask):
        return 0.0 # Fallback if no points in range
    return float(np.mean(arr_y[mask]))

b_left = get_mean(x, y1, 1100)
b_right = get_mean(x, y1, 1800)

# Calculate linear baseline for current x array
if b_left != b_right:
    slope = (b_right - b_left) / (1800.0 - 1100.0)
    baseline = b_left + slope * (x - 1100.0)
else:
    baseline = np.full_like(x, b_left)

# Subtract baseline
y1 = y1 - baseline

# Normalize G-band (1550-1620) max to 1
g_mask = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
if np.any(g_mask):
    g_max = np.max(y1[g_mask])
    if g_max > 0:
        y1 = y1 / g_max
    else:
        # If max is negative or zero due to noise, set to 1 to avoid div by zero/negative scale issues visually, 
        # though strictly it means no positive peak.
        pass
